name: Noxus
basis: Noxus's own public pages and, for company basics only, the news sources named beside each fact
what: Noxus sells a platform on which companies build AI agents, which it calls AI Workers or Co-workers, and automated flows that carry out back-office processes in the companies' own systems.

solutions.name: Noxus AI Workers (AI Co-workers; 'Agents' in the documentation)
solutions.what: Configurable agents that use flows, integration actions, knowledge bases, tables, MCP servers, code execution and a sandbox to carry out tasks, deployed through the web app, API, SDK, chat widget, Slack, Teams, Google Chat, WhatsApp or Telegram.

solutions.name: Flows
solutions.what: Visual node-based workflows with triggers, AI nodes and integration nodes.

solutions.name: Knowledge Bases and Tables
solutions.what: Document stores with semantic search, and structured tables, that agents and flows query.

solutions.name: Case management and processes
solutions.what: Processes whose cases are worked by flows and by people through tasks.

solutions.name: Genie
solutions.what: An assistant inside the platform that builds and changes flows, agents and tables, asking for approval before writes.
solutions.status: beta, off until an administrator turns it on

solutions.name: Noxus MCP server, Python SDK and REST API
solutions.short: Noxus MCP server, Python SDK a
solutions.what: A hosted MCP server, SDK and REST API that let external clients and agents drive workflows, agents and conversations.

stories.what: Patient messages categorised, routed and processed by an AI Worker; the page gives 3,000+ communications a month and complex cases routed to staff.
